title: ShinyHunters claims return after arrests, signs messages with old PGP keys
date_note: BleepingComputer (24 November) says the posts appeared on a new Tor leak site launched on 23 November.
summary: BleepingComputer reports that the ShinyHunters extortion group says it is back, in posts on a new Tor leak site launched on 23 November. The group says a former member is cooperating with authorities and that it rotated a PGP key. BleepingComputer says it verified two messages signed with 2020 ShinyHunters keys, but the keys circulated widely, so they do not prove the group has returned.
plain: The ShinyHunters extortion group says it has returned after arrests. BleepingComputer checked old digital signatures, but says they do not prove the group is back.
exec: An unproven claim that a data-extortion group is active again; BleepingComputer says the signatures do not prove the group has returned.

validation.note: Single publisher (BleepingComputer); the group's own claim, signatures not proof of identity per the article.

review.note: Compared claim status, leak-site date, key rotation, 2020-key signatures and caveat with BleepingComputer
